thread:
maya: FYI we pulled an SFTP drop from partner X (sftp://ingest.partnerx.com/drops/2026-04-01.tar.gz) and inside theres a file named credentials.enc that header-identifies as vault-transit wrapped by key wrap-key-2026. treating as potential exposure.
leo: thanks, can you upload the exact file hash and header? and flag partner contact?
maya: sha256: b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfade... header shows: vault-transit:v1; wrap-metadata: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-2026
auditbot: Alert: unusual kms.decrypt activity on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/wrap-key-2026 — 12 attempts from partner-sa@partner-project in last 30m.
ralph: ok immediate plan: 1) snapshot the original SFTP drop (read-only) 2) freeze partner SA decrypt perms on wrap-key-2026 3) run non-destructive rewrap to new key wrap-key-2026-rot and put artifacts into a quarantine bucket 4) run regex scan of archive for plaintext secrets and known token patterns 5) escalate to legal/partner success if PII/creds confirmed.
sophia: i'm on legal loop. do not delete or rewrap until legal signs off on evidence handoff unless we confirm active exploit. but we can prepare rotation runbook.
leo: commands i'll run now: 
```
# list kms key bindings
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy wrap-key-2026 --location=global --keyring=partner --format=json | jq
# check vault audit for transit unwraps
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="vault_instance" AND protoPayload.methodName:unwrap' --project=redwood-prod --limit=500
```
maya: scanning archive with ripgrep for likely secrets (local staging, not uploading):
```
rg --hidden --no-ignore -i "(api_key|secret|token|password|private_key)" 2026-04-01.tar.gz || true
```
infra-oncall: i can perform a rotation without downtime if clients can tolerate key rollover semantics. prefer to create wrap-key-2026-rot as a new cryptoKeyVersion, add to vault transit keyring, update ingesters to prefer new version, then schedule phased disable of old decrypt bit.
ralph: operational constraints: partner ingestion pipeline may still try to upload new drops wrapped with wrap-key-2026. propose we ask partner to flip to the new key concurrently, and add a short grace period for acceptance of v1 and v2.
auditbot: Note: created investigation ticket SEC-2026-089 and extended vault & cloudkms audit retention to 120 days.
leo: initial findings: ripgrep hit two likely high-entropy strings inside credentials.enc after streaming a safe-layer inspection: flagged as "possible API token". no evidence of local unwrap attempts by our services in the logs.
sophia: legal requests we package the artifact and the blurred samples, and send via secure intake to partner success. do not rewrap or change ACLs before partner acknowlegdes receipt unless we see active misuse.
maya: i'm quarantining a copy to gs://redwood-quarantine/SEC-2026-089/ingest-2026-04-01.tar.gz (object set to readonly and logged). posting checksum and access controls to ticket.
ralph: RBAC plan (leo + ralph): 1) remove broad roles/owner on wrap-key-2026 for partner SA 2) add kms.cryptoKeys.get and kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt only for specific principals we trust 3) add condition restricting principal to originating external IP ranges / bucket origin when possible. draft PR targeting infra/ops config.
infra-oncall: runbook steps i'm drafting: create new key version, add to vault transit config, run streaming rewrap for recent 72h drops to quarantine bucket, verify checksums, flip ingesters to prefer new version, then disable decrypt on old key (do not destroy). fallback: put ingress in read-only for partner until rotation accepted.
leo: estimating 4h for RBAC PR + testing. maya: ETA for quarantine upload and samples to legal?
maya: done upload, notified partner-success & legal (they acknowledged, waiting for partner reply).
auditbot: Reminder: preserve logs and escalate to SOC if any external IPs show unusual access patterns.
sophia: legal asks we avoid automated rewrap until partner confirms chain-of-custody. we can still prepare the scripts and test them in staging.
ralph: agreed. everyone keep posts concise to this thread. once partner confirms we will proceed with non-destructive rewrap and revoke/deprecate old key. thanks. :lock:
